run_BaseExtractionPipeline_execute: run the BaseExtractionPipeline execute method to extract data from an InputDocument and return an ExtractionResult
create_BaseExtractionPipeline_instance: create a BaseExtractionPipeline instance with PipelineOptions to configure artifacts path and model loading
build_BaseExtractionPipeline_subclass: build a subclass of BaseExtractionPipeline implementing _extract_data and _determine_status abstract methods
review_BaseExtractionPipeline_get_defaul: review the BaseExtractionPipeline get_default_options class method to retrieve default PipelineOptions
test_BaseExtractionPipeline_error_handli: test the BaseExtractionPipeline execute method error handling with raises_on_error flag enabled
